title: Capillarity
definition: Capillarity is the spontaneous rise or fall of a liquid in a narrow tube (capillary) due to the interplay of cohesive and adhesive forces, governed by surface tension.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Prelims under General Science (Physics) to evaluate conceptual clarity on fluid mechanics, surface tension, and real-world natural phenomena.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Capillarity.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
